label: "Account Suspended" — PayPal impersonation
subject: Your account has been limited
body:
Dear Customer,

We noticed unusual activity on your account. Your access has been suspended until you verify your identity.

[Verify Your Account](http://paypa1-alerts.com/verify?id=8213)

Failure to verify within 24 hours will result in permanent suspension of your account.

PayPal Security Team

subject: We couldn't process your payment
body:
